evidence: Base.lproj GoToDay, Subscribe, Publish, AlarmCustom, BackupRestore, TimeZonePickerSheet and *Inspector nibs
REA open_binary refused (extract has no Contents/MacOS executable), so nibs were read as archive string tables

features.apple: PreferencesPanel.nib natural-language creation; File > New Event
features.note: Event > Quick Event... (Cmd+Shift+N) opens a sheet with one line; it previews the title, day, time, place and notes read from the sentence (text after the note marker), and Add saves the event at once. The reading is tested headless in tests/parity_app-calendar.rs. File > New Event from Text still reads the pasteboard; not yet verified on Midget. Left: invitees are not read from the sentence, and the line is a sheet rather than a toolbar popover.
features.wire: Move the line into a toolbar popover opened by the New Event button, and read notes and invitees from the sentence.

features.apple: MainMenu.nib View > Go to Today, Next, Previous

features.note: Go to Date sheet (Go menu, Shift-Command-T) with year/month/day steppers, Return/Escape; no typed date or calendar-grid picker, no sheet accessibility nodes yet
features.wire: Replace the steppers with a month-grid date picker when the kit has one.

features.feature: Event editor: title, location, notes, all-day, start/end

features.note: The Repeat row opens a picker under it: Frequency (Never, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly), Every N, the weekdays of a weekly rule, and Ends (Never, After N times, Until a date). A preset is saved as before; any other rule is saved as its RRULE in calendar-extras.txt (src/calendar/extras.rs) and worked out in Calendar::occurs (src/calendar/overlay.rs:122). Not yet verified on Midget. Left: copy and paste and the print agenda carry only the preset, so a custom rule is not copied or printed.
features.wire: Add a Custom repeat sheet (frequency, interval, weekdays, end after N / on date) that writes an RRULE into the rich sidecar via calendar/exchange.rs; open it from Target::Repeat.

features.note: The Alert row opens a checklist of the seven presets (several can be on), a custom alarm from 0 minutes to a week in 5-minute steps, and a row that removes each custom alarm. The alarms are kept in calendar-extras.txt and scheduled one by one through alert_calendar_with (src/calendar/alerts.rs:24). Not yet verified on Midget. Left: copy and paste and the .ics export keep only the first preset.
features.wire: Allow a list of alerts per event plus a Custom alert sheet (N minutes/hours/days before, or at a time); store as VALARMs in the rich sidecar and schedule each in connect.rs plan_alerts.

features.note: Undo bar, not the shell Edit > Undo stack

Edit > Cut/Copy/Paste from the shell Edit menu now act on the saved event being edited (Cut = copy then delete with Undo; Paste adds the pasteboard event to the selected day); Event > Cut Event (Shift-Command-X). Copy/Cut work only from the open editor; the month and week grids have no selected-event state, and text selection copy inside the editor fields is not routed. A custom repeat rule and custom alarms now go with the event through copy and paste (clip.rs copy_text and paste, tested headless in tests/parity_app-calendar.rs).
features.wire: Select an event with a single click (the grid opens it today) and keep custom repeat rules when pasting once the custom repeat sheet exists.

features.apple: Info.plist CFBundleDocumentTypes ICS/vCal; File > Import; ImportProgress.nib
features.note: File > Import... plus opening .ics files from Files (Input::Open, manifest handles public.calendar-event). Still no import progress UI.
features.wire: Check File > Import... and opening an .ics from Files on Midget; recurring events are expanded one year ahead, as for CalDAV.

features.note: File > Export Calendar Archive writes Calendar Archive.bfcal (events.tsv and calendar.ics in one file, calendar/archive.rs), through the save job in main.rs. File > Import Calendar Archive... adds the events the calendar does not hold and never removes any (archive.rs merge_events), keeping events.tsv.bak.
features.wire: Check File > Export Archive... and Import Archive... on Midget; an import adds what is missing and never removes, so a restore over a changed calendar is a merge.

features.feature: Multiple calendars with colours: new, rename, delete, show/hide
features.apple: File > New Calendar, New Calendar Group; LocalCalendarInspector.nib; Get Info
features.note: File > New Calendar... makes a calendar from a line sheet; File > Rename Calendar and File > Delete Calendar work on each calendar made. Each calendar has a palette colour and its own row in the calendar list that shows or hides it, a Calendar row in the event form, and Settings > Default Calendar. Up to ten calendars, the built-in one included. Delete is refused while the calendar holds events, and the message says to delete them first. The calendars and the events' calendar ids are kept in calendar-extras.txt (src/calendar/extras.rs:56). Not yet verified on Midget. Left: Get Info, calendar groups, choosing a colour, and moving events to another calendar on delete.
features.wire: Give saved events a calendar id and colour (store column or sidecar), add File > New Calendar, rename and delete, a Get Info inspector and a calendar popup in the editor.

features.apple: MainMenu.nib Edit > Search; toolbar search field
features.note: Go > Search Events... (Command-F) and a toolbar button open a search screen with a query field and scrolling result list; Return or a click opens the event. Saved events match on title, location and notes, and from:YYYY-MM-DD and to:YYYY-MM-DD words limit the hits to a date range (search.rs, tested headless in tests/parity_app-calendar.rs). Uses its own list rather than the kit search_field; the caret does not move by click.
features.wire: Match locations and notes of saved events (the store keeps them, search.rs reads only titles for them), search by date range, and move the caret by click. The compliance snapshot needs a re-bless on Midget for the new toolbar field.

features.feature: Drag to create / move events in Day and Week
features.note: Dragging empty hour-grid space sizes a new event (15 minute snap) and opens the editor; dragging a timed event moves it across times and week days and saves; grabbing its top or bottom edge resizes it to the snapped minute (layout::drag_resize, tested headless in tests/parity_app-calendar.rs). Left: all-day events cannot be dragged, the drag starts only after a 250 ms hold, and the travel time padding is not resized with the edge.
features.wire: Drag at once (no 250 ms hold) when the pointer is a mouse and scrolling has another input; drag all-day events between days.

features.apple: PreferencesPanel.nib Accounts; CalDAVCalendarInspector.nib; View > Refresh Calendars
features.note: CalDAV calendars are read in the background and imported into the store. View > Refresh Calendars (Cmd+R) starts a read now (springboard/sdk/src/dav_sync.rs refresh). Not yet verified on Midget. Left: writing local saves and deletes back with PUT and DELETE, and one calendar per account in the calendar list.
features.wire: Push local saves/deletes with dav_sync PUT/DELETE, keep each account as its own calendar in the sidebar, add Refresh Calendars (cmd+r) to View.

features.apple: Subscribe.nib; File > New Calendar Subscription; Info.plist webcal scheme
features.note: File > New Calendar Subscription... opens a line sheet filled from the pasteboard. Return subscribes; an address that is refused keeps the sheet open with the reason. webcal:// and https:// calendars are read every hour, cached for offline start, shown or hidden from the list, and removed with File > Unsubscribe from. Not yet verified on Midget. Left: a refresh interval per calendar, and a check of a real webcal feed on Midget.
features.wire: Replace File > Subscribe to Calendar from Clipboard with a New Calendar Subscription sheet (an address field), add a per-calendar refresh interval, and check a real webcal feed on Midget.

features.note: Holidays row in the calendar list shows Iceland's public holidays and observances (Easter computed) as read-only all-day events; no Birthdays calendar yet; built on parity/team-d-calendar; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Add the Birthdays calendar from the Contacts service (needs an async contacts query from the app), a region choice for the holidays, and a Settings toggle for each.

features.feature: Settings: general (week start, day start/end, days per week, default duration, default calendar)
features.note: File > Settings... (Command-comma) sheet: week start, day start hour, default duration; persisted in calendar-prefs.txt (calendar/prefs.rs) and used by the month grid, week view, scroll position and new events. The default calendar is a Default Calendar submenu (main.rs:85). Missing: day end, days per week, and a separate Settings window (no shell Settings hook found).
features.wire: Add day end hour, days per week and a default calendar (needs multiple calendars) to the Settings menu in main.rs.

features.note: Default alert for timed and all-day events in the Settings sheet; applied to new drafts and swapped when All-day is toggled. Birthday default alert missing (no Birthdays calendar).
features.wire: Add a default alert for birthdays once the Birthdays calendar exists.

features.apple: PreferencesPanel.nib time zone support; TimeZonePickerSheet.nib; InspectorTimeZoneView.nib
features.note: A Time Zone row in the event form cycles the device's zone, UTC and Iceland (the fixed-offset zones; extras.rs ZONES). The zone sets the alarms (alerts.rs:24) and is written as TZID in the .ics export (extras.rs apply_zones). Not yet verified on Midget. Left: a view time-zone override in the toolbar, zones with daylight saving, and converting the displayed times to the view's zone.
features.wire: Add a time zone popup in the editor (TZID in the rich sidecar) and a toolbar view time-zone override in chrome.rs.

features.note: Read-only list of imported attendees; cannot add or invite
features.wire: Add an Add Invitees field with contacts autocomplete and send iTIP REQUEST mail through the Mail service.

features.feature: Respond to invitations; show declined events
features.apple: View > Show Declined Events; notifications settings
features.wire: Show Accept/Maybe/Decline on events with a pending PARTSTAT for the user, reply via iTIP, and a View toggle for declined events.

features.feature: Data detectors in event (address from notes, copy phone)
Alerts in notifications, Up Next widget, Dock date

features.note: File > Print... (Cmd+P) sends the shown day, week, month or year as a plain-text agenda to the printing service, not a picture of the grid; built on parity/team-d-calendar; not yet verified on Midget
features.wire: Draw the month grid and the day and week columns onto the pages (PrintOperation::pages) instead of an agenda list; text prints in ASCII only, so accented letters need the page writer's font support.

features.apple: Publish.nib, PubSuccess.nib; Edit > Share, Stop Publishing
features.note: Tied to the vendor cloud calendar service
Exchange-server specific

features.feature: Travel time and Time to Leave
features.apple: View > Show Travel Time; Time to Leave setting
features.note: A Travel Time row in the event form (none, 15, 30, 45 or 60 minutes) saved with the event (extras.rs). The Day and Week grids pad the event block upwards by its travel time, never before midnight (layout.rs travel_span, tested headless in tests/parity_app-calendar.rs). Not used for alerts. Left: Time to Leave, which needs a routing service.
features.wire: Add a travel-time field in the editor that pads the event block; Time to Leave alerts once a maps routing service exists.
Read dated reminders from the Reminders store and draw them as all-day items, with a View toggle.
Offer opening the editor in a second window through the SDK multi-window API.

features.feature: Zoom in / out of the time grid
features.note: Zoom level is now saved with the settings and restored on start.
features.wire: Verify Cmd+= / Cmd+- and the toolbar on Midget.

features.feature: User activities / intents (show date, show event, create event)
features.note: Intents show-date, show-event and create-event (intents.rs), and control methods calendar.state, calendar.show_date, calendar.create_event. No user-activity handoff.
features.wire: Add a continue-activity hook (Search items for events), a show-day intent that picks the view, and a reply with the event for create-event.
